features.name: Druidic
features.description: You know Druidic, the secret language of druids.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You can cast druid spells; your spellcasting ability is Wisdom.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.description: As an action, transform into a beast you have seen; duration and uses scale with level. CR, swim speed, and fly speed limits apply by druid level.

features.name: Timeless Body
features.description: You age slowly; you no longer need food or water, and you age only one year for every ten that pass.

features.name: Beast Spells
features.description: You can cast many of your druid spells in any shape you assume using Wild Shape.

features.name: Archdruid
features.description: You can use Wild Shape an unlimited number of times.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Land
subclasses.description: Druids tied to a terrain type, gaining extra spells and recovery of magical energy from the land.

features.name: Bonus Cantrip
features.description: You learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice.

features.name: Natural Recovery
features.description: During a short rest, recover expended spell slots with combined level up to half your druid level (rounded up), none above 5th level.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.description: You gain bonus spells at certain levels based on the terrain type associated with your circle (arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, swamp, or underdark).

features.name: Land's Stride
features.description: Moving through nonmagical difficult terrain costs you no extra movement; you have advantage on saving throws against plants that are magically created or manipulated to impede movement.

features.name: Nature's Ward
features.description: You are immune to charm and fright from elementals and fey, and you are immune to poison and disease.

features.name: Nature's Sanctuary
features.description: Creatures of the natural world hesitate to attack you; when a beast or plant attacks you, it must make a Wisdom save or choose a different target.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Moon
subclasses.description: Druids who emphasize combat in beast form and greater Wild Shape potency.

features.name: Combat Wild Shape
features.description: Wild Shape can be used as a bonus action; while transformed, you can expend spell slots to regain hit points as a bonus action.

features.name: Circle Forms
features.description: You can transform into a beast with challenge rating 1 or lower (instead of 1/4 without swim, etc., at this level), subject to other Wild Shape limits.

features.name: Primal Strike
features.description: Your attacks in beast form count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks.

features.name: Elemental Wild Shape
features.description: You can expend two uses of Wild Shape at once to assume an air, earth, fire, or water elemental form.

features.name: Thousand Forms
features.description: You can cast alter self at will, without expending a spell slot.
